Resize.description: Resize the input image to the given size

size.description: Desired output size of the crop

CenterCrop.description: Crops the given image at the center

scale.description: Range of fraction of area to crop

ratio.description: Range of aspect ratio of crop

RandomResizedCrop.description: Crop the image to a random size and aspect ratio, then resize

RandomHorizontalFlip.description: Horizontally flip the image randomly with a given probability

RandomVerticalFlip.description: Vertically flip the image randomly with a given probability

degrees.description: Range of degrees to select from

RandomRotation.description: Rotate the image by a random angle

ColorJitter.description: Randomly change the brightness, contrast, saturation and hue of an image

sigma.description: Standard deviation range for Gaussian kernel

GaussianBlur.description: Blur the image with a Gaussian blur kernel

scale.description: Range of proportion of erased area

ratio.description: Range of aspect ratio of erased area

RandomErasing.description: Randomly select a rectangle region in the image and erase its pixels

ToTensor.description: Convert a PIL Image or numpy.ndarray to tensor and scale to [0, 1]

mean.description: Sequence of means for each channel

std.description: Sequence of standard deviations for each channel

Normalize.description: Normalize a tensor image with mean and standard deviation
